Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated two different people named Roy Mack—the film director and the baseball executive—treating Washington, D.C. (the baseball executive’s birthplace) as a conflicting birthplace for the director. Despite credible sources visible shortly after (e.g., “Roy Mack (director)” on Wikipedia and IMDb) showing the director was born in New Brunswick, New Jersey, the Planner continued to frame this as a conflict, causing unnecessary iterations and preventing a correct, timely conclusion.
